items.text: Fixed "Show use bind" and "Show belt bar binds" settings so they now work correctly.
Adjusted conversation readout timings for clearer dialogue.
Fixed crash when using the building planner to place collapsed structures.
Reduced network groups for indoor rooms, improving server stability and reducing lag.
Introduced a repairable helipad at the bandit camp; players must contribute resources to unlock air vehicle purchases. The helipad stays repaired across wipes.
Optimized map erosion processing, cutting erosion time from 47 seconds to 39 seconds.
Fixed empty procmap scene that could cause map loading issues.
Cached rocket ammo definitions for attack helicopters, reducing potential lag during rocket attacks.

2026-08-20.summary:
### UI & Settings
- Fixed "Show use bind" and "Show belt bar binds" settings so they now work correctly.
- Adjusted conversation readout timings for clearer dialogue.

### World & Structures
- Fixed crash when using the building planner to place collapsed structures.
- Reduced network groups for indoor rooms, improving server stability and reducing lag.

### Upcoming Features
- Introduced a repairable helipad at the bandit camp; players must contribute resources to unlock air vehicle purchases. The helipad stays repaired across wipes.

### Performance & Stability
- Optimized map erosion processing, cutting erosion time from 47 seconds to 39 seconds.
- Fixed empty procmap scene that could cause map loading issues.
- Cached rocket ammo definitions for attack helicopters, reducing potential lag during rocket attacks.
